reason: A chat utility that lets users attach arbitrary dragged files and quote selected conversation text, storing sent attachments in a system temporary directory for model access.

summaries.zh: 为对话界面提供文件拖拽附件和选中文本引用功能，并在发送时将附件暂存到系统临时目录。
summaries.en: Adds drag-and-drop file attachments and selected-text quoting to the chat interface, temporarily storing sent files for model access.

capabilities: Captures files dragged into the chat interface
Uploads file bytes to a local host endpoint or host handler
Writes uploaded files to a system temporary directory
Captures selected conversation text for inclusion in a message
Intercepts chat submission actions to combine attachments and quoted text
